notes.title: [Major Update] KONSAIRI Version 1.2!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38927010/61e8d52e2dcdc0900f7b93f0f2195c6480e28173.png
Version 1.2 update contents
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38927010/ed729fba6e14ac6d26aef79a7753f441ea1b34ac.png
Golden dishes will be added!
With this, good things will happen!

 On-the-fly recovery when you run out of life, and the design of Ruth's hair ornament will change!
 NPC HEALTH will be greatly increased!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38927010/657e42e0d864d1f2f75650c355bf427618315055.png
Let's find some recipe combinations that'll make you cook golden!

Now you won't get lost? More features to help you on your journey!

 Paths to different areas, ROOMs, and dungeons are now color-coded!
 You can now see the map from the Adventure screen!


Inventory can now be opened using only the menu button (START)!
There are other updated elements as well. I suggest you check the manual!

Additional content
Particles when touching grass that pulls out root vegetables
Color-coded pins for "ROOM" and "DUNGEON ENTRANCE".
Avatar change appearance to cooking screen (requires complete pack)
Smoothly moving virus eyes (animation)
Golden cooking elements
Anti-slip on burdocks
Check the map at any time
Up + X action to throw root vegetables backwards
Residents dozing animation
Consiliki particles added
Ruth delivers a soliloquy message
Show the healthiest residents with ★
Show root vegetables that are going to become seeds in the meal results screen
Fade between cooking screen and adventure screen
Adjustment
Prevent AGILITY, VELOCITY, and JUMP from dropping to 1
Adjusted some songs
Changed day/night time zone, longer in the morning and shorter in the evening
Camera behavior
Color of unsupported dungeon pillars
Meal cooldown time for Lord of the Black Pots
Changed background color of some areas
Changed block placement in some areas
Cleared a route for sowing seeds in the CASKET area
Menu button only for inventory, long press for system menu
Achromatic ◎ button for areas that cannot be selected on the guide map
Pause the label on the area name display
Added support for "◎ while pressing up" for dungeon "cut through action
Underwater behavior, speed, etc.
Adjusted NPC Health for each root vegetable (downward adjustment)
Gave teachable paths to residents who can't tell you the way
Adjusted the graphics of residents.
Adjusted locations of residents, roots, viruses, doors, etc.
3D model design of dungeon objects
Bug fixes
Stabilized particle generation
Damage may be caused by using GARLIC when adjacent to a virus in a dungeon
The map shows root vegetables that have not been planted.
A door near a wall causes a hammering.
You don't get a seed right after you get a seed.
Viruses that should be deleted in time get accumulated
The fade from the title to the demo scene is unnatural

notes.title: [MINOR UPDATE] Version 1.1b
notes.notes:
Fixes and Changes in KONSAIRI Version 1.1b

 Fixed a tile pattern that could cause block jamming.
 Fixed an error that occurred when using GARLIC twice in a row.
 Fixed spelling of GALIC to GARLIC.
 Subdivided the sound effects in KONPSI.


If you are stuck on a block, please contact us with a screenshot or something you can refer to. We will investigate.
In case this happens, the best way to avoid it is to hold down the key opposite to the direction you want to go.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38927010/7bc133032fe8f19b2a2c028cfa61d1ed586abe0c.gif

notes.title: [UPDATE] Version 1.1
notes.notes:
We've made some minor bug fixes, tweaks to the game's ease of play and minor bug fixes, while reflecting feedback.
There's even an additional update to make it look gorgeous!

Add

 Gritty effect while walking
 Jump, Veggie pop effect
 KONPSI Effects
 Sowing Effects
 KUWAI make the grass glow blue
 Color coding for each dungeon
 BELL sorted during the map guide
 Guide, view ROOM (Area 16) in Fast Travel
 Show the total time for life consumption of the game (not gameplay time) after the ending


Adjustment
Adjusted the following contents

 Show only the pins, not the icons of unreached areas in the map guide
 Indicates that the inventory BELL is 7 pieces of inventory
 Seed acquisition requirements, changed from a health value of 61 or more to 60 or more
 DECIDE cursor movement speed up and color change in the meal screen
 Veggie7 pieces growing in the first area can be quickly regrown
 GARLIC virus seal becomes invalid over time
 Adjust the conditions for getting a hint of the order of BELL
 On failure of BURDOCK (0-stage installation) does not consume
 Fixing Ruth's face in the dungeon
 Adjust the 1px floating display position of the inhabitants
 Black pot, black BELL display further black (CARBON GRAPHITE)
 Adjust the afterimage of the knife
 Lighten the operation by caching some data (in the range of the virtual CPU)
 Adjust the color of the block background in some areas



Bugs fixed and resolved
Fixed the following bugs and glitches

 Error in some areas during avatar change use
 Error when entering a dungeon without getting a bell
 Fast travel occurs upon death in dungeons
 Go from Ringpool to Telescope and back again
 Fast Travel into Nest and the background music is different
 Throwing Veggie when agility16 gets you instantly
 The discomfort of looking out from within the walls of the dungeon
 Mis-timing of the dungeon's virus traverse
 Accepting keys on the way to open the inventory in a dungeon
 Putting the Veggie in inventory first blank and cannot be replaced

notes.title: [UPDATE] Version 1.0a
notes.notes:
Changed the jump at the beginning of the game from 1 to 2.

This change allows you to climb the waterfall and turn back with the default jump power in the "HILLSIDE-TORRENT" (third) area.

If you got stuck in previous versions of the game, we recommend that you select **REMOVE DATA** from the title screen and start over.
